summary: Project now includes a wallet/balance system requirement: an admin wallet starting at 10,000 that is the sole source of user balances, with secure database persistence, real-time balance updates after transactions, and UI balance displays (wallet indicator positioned top-right under the Profile control; admin total balance in admin dashboard) in a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design.
architectural_notes: Project type: Node.js Express app; serves HTML (currently via res.send) and static assets from /public.
Routes planned/used: GET / (landing), GET /credits, GET /status/:id, GET /admin.
Order concept: store orders in an in-memory array (orders) with fields like id, url, pkg, status, time; used by /status and /admin.
Dashboard variant introduces in-memory users array (id, name, balance, ref) and orders array; served to frontend via GET /api/users returning {users, orders}.
Frontend dashboard script fetches /api/users to populate users/orders client-side; order placement is simulated client-side (status update via setTimeout) and does not persist to server orders array.
UI decision: place the Dashboard "Profile" option control in the header at the top-right corner for clear discoverability.

Add persistent wallet/balance storage in a database with an admin-only distribution flow (admin wallet is the sole source of user balances) and real-time UI updates after transactions (e.g., via polling/websocket/SSE).

UI placement decision update: move the fixed wallet/balance indicator from top-left to the top-right area directly under the Profile control (profile menu/button), ensuring no overlap and good mobile/desktop readability.

User requested adding a PHP session + MySQL balance lookup snippet to the index page; current project stack is Node/React/Motoko, so this behavior must be mapped/ported to the existing authentication + wallet backend rather than directly using PHP.

User provided a MySQL/PHP reference flow for admin-wallet distribution: an `admin` table with a single row balance=10000; on user creation, check admin.balance >= allocated amount, insert user with that balance, and deduct the same amount from admin.balance.
known_issues: Home page HTML string uses ${window.location.href} in server-side template string; will throw because window is undefined on the server.
orders is referenced in /status/:id and /admin but not defined/initialized in the provided code.
/status/:id and /admin routes appear after app.listen; ordering is non-idiomatic and may confuse expected setup flow.
Dashboard header area (including the 'Your Site' invite URL and balance) is not visible to the user; invite URL cannot be found in the UI.
Wallet/balance UI element in the top-left is not visible/noticeable for the user; needs size/style adjustments to improve discoverability/readability (especially on mobile).

User-provided wallet/balance HTML snippet uses fixed top-left positioning (top:10px; left:10px), which conflicts with the requirement to place the global balance indicator top-right under the Profile control.

User provided a PHP/session-based implementation for balance display, which does not match the current Node/React/Motoko architecture; clarify/implement equivalent balance-fetching via the app’s backend/auth model.

existing_features.title: Create a marketing-style Home page for the app named "tiktok-booster" that includes: (1) hero title "TikTok Booster Pro" and subtitle "Instant Views • Likes • Followers | 100% Safe"; (2) three package cards (Starter $5: 10K Views, 500 Likes, 24h Delivery; Pro $15: 50K Views, 2K Likes, 12h Delivery; VIP $35: 100K Views, 5K Likes, 6h Delivery) each with a "Buy Now" CTA that selects the package; (3) an order form section with a TikTok URL input placeholder "https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/123456" and a "Start Boosting" button; (4) a footer containing a link to the Credits page and a referral/share section showing the current page URL and a "Copy & Share (Earn 20%)" button.

Add a Credits page/route that displays credits/contact information and a back link to the Home page. User-facing text must be in English and include: "TikTok Booster Pro – Pentest & Marketing Tool", "Built by: Cybersecurity Pro | HackerAI Assisted", "Features: Real-time API, Mobile Responsive, Referral System", "Contact: Telegram: @tiktokboosterpro | Email: support@tiktokboost.pro", and a disclaimer "For educational & authorized testing only | No real TikTok API".

Implement order creation and tracking using the Motoko backend: when a user selects a package and submits a TikTok URL, create a new Order record with fields {id, url, package, status, createdAt}. Return the created order id to the frontend and show an order confirmation UI that includes the selected package, price, and a link to view order status at /status/:id. Do not integrate any real TikTok API; treat this as a mock/educational flow.

Add a Status page/route at /status/:id that fetches the Order by id from the backend and displays: order id, video URL, package, status (highlighted), and created time. If the order does not exist, show an English "Order not found" message and a link back to Home.
Add an Admin analytics page/route at /admin that displays total orders and a readable JSON view/table of all orders fetched from the backend (id, url, package, status, createdAt).

Replace the server-side usage pattern of `${window.location.href}` with correct client-side rendering: any display of the current page URL must be computed in the browser and never referenced from the backend/canister code.

Define and apply a coherent visual theme across all pages (Home, Credits, Status, Admin) using Tailwind: choose a distinct style suitable for a marketing landing page (colors, typography, spacing, card/button styles) and apply it consistently. Do not use a blue+purple gradient as the primary background.

Generate and add static image assets to support the theme and render them in the UI as appropriate (e.g., logo in header, subtle background graphic). Store generated images in frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

Add a new React route and page that recreates the provided "Caffeine Dashboard" UI as a first-class page in the existing app (do not use Express). The page must include: (1) a header showing the title "Caffeine TikTok Booster", the line "Your Site: https://tik-tok-booster-1--tayyabrandhawa1.replit.app", and a prominent "Balance: $<amount>" display; (2) a 2x2 responsive card grid containing "Quick Order (Low Price!)", "Add User", "Recent Orders", and "Users" sections; (3) English-only labels/messages and validations.

Wire the dashboard page to the Motoko backend using React Query hooks, mirroring the client flow from the provided Express example: on page load, fetch users and orders and populate "Users" and "Recent Orders" lists; provide an "Add User" form that creates a new user and updates the UI after success; keep all user-facing notifications in English.

Implement "Quick Order (Low Price!)" behavior on the dashboard page: accept a TikTok video URL input, allow selecting a package consistent with the provided code’s pricing (Starter $1, Pro $3, VIP $7) and show these prices in the UI; prevent ordering when the current balance is below the selected price; when an order is placed, deduct the price from the displayed balance and add it to the top of the "Recent Orders" list with a status that transitions from "Processing..." to "Completed!" after a short simulated delay (client-side simulation is acceptable; do not integrate any real TikTok API). All prompts and messages must be in English.

Implement the "Add User +$50 Balance" behavior on the dashboard page: submitting a valid new user increases the displayed balance by $50 and adds the user to the users list with an initial balance of 100 and the provided referral code (or a generated one when empty). All validations/messages must be in English.

Update the app’s package/pricing configuration to use PKR and provide more package options than the current three, including at least the two tiers requested: (a) 50 PKR = 5K views + 500 likes; (b) 100 PKR = 10K views + 1K likes + shares. Ensure the package list is used consistently by the marketing Home page and its order confirmation panel (prices/benefits). All user-facing labels remain in English.

Update delivery time messaging/options to reflect a 5–10 minute duration (instead of hours) wherever package delivery time is shown in the UI for the updated PKR packages. If a delivery time is displayed in package benefits, it must show 5–10 minutes.

Change the Dashboard starting balance display to 10,000 PKR (not $500) and update the Dashboard UI to display currency as PKR consistently (header balance, user balances, and quick-order prices). All user-facing text must remain English.

Update the Dashboard “Quick Order” package pricing to PKR and align it with the new PKR tiers (including at least 50 PKR and 100 PKR options). Ordering must be blocked when the current Dashboard balance is below the selected PKR price; when an order is placed, deduct the PKR amount from the displayed Dashboard balance and continue the existing local order simulation (Processing → Completed).

Extend user management to allow adding users by URL: add a “User URL” field to the Dashboard “Add User” form, store this URL on the user record, and display the stored URL in the Users list. Keep all validations/messages in English.

Replace the current Dashboard “Add User +$50 Balance” earning mechanic with a balance allocation/division flow: allow the admin to input an “Allocated Balance (PKR)” amount when creating a user; on success, subtract the allocated amount from the main Dashboard balance and set the created user’s balance to the allocated amount. Prevent creating a user if the allocation exceeds the current main balance; show an English validation error.

Add Dashboard sections/options for “Profile”, “Project”, and “Draft” as visible UI areas in the Dashboard (e.g., additional cards or a navigation + panels). Because behavior/fields are not specified, each section must at minimum render an English “Coming soon” style placeholder and not break existing dashboard functionality.

Ensure the Dashboard page at route "/dashboard" has a clearly visible, always-discoverable header area that displays (a) the title "Caffeine TikTok Booster", (b) the invite line exactly "Your Site: https://tik-tok-booster-1--tayyabrandhawa1.replit.app", and (c) the current "Balance: <amount> PKR". The header must be readable on mobile and desktop without being visually lost against the background.

Add a clear invite URL copy control in the Dashboard header so users can easily copy the invite link. All user-facing text must be in English (e.g., button label "Copy Invite Link" and toast messages).

Add a visible "Profile" option within the Dashboard UI navigation (e.g., a header/nav button or tab) that takes the user to the existing "Profile" section/card in the dashboard. Keep all user-facing text in English.

On the /dashboard page, reposition the existing "Profile" navigation control so it is clearly located in the top-right corner of the sticky header area on both mobile and desktop, while keeping its current behavior (scrolling to/focusing the Profile section card) unchanged.

Add a dedicated, responsive Profile page route ("/profile") and make it accessible via a clearly visible Profile control located in the top-right corner of the UI (on both mobile and desktop). The Profile page must be clean, modern, and mobile-friendly.

Implement the Profile page UI sections and controls: profile picture upload, username and bio fields, email and phone number fields, an "Edit Profile" action that enables editing, a "Save Changes" action that persists updates, a "Change Password" option, and a "Logout" button.

Wire the Profile page to the Motoko backend so the authenticated user can load and save their own profile data, including profile picture (as a text-encoded image such as a data URL), username, bio, email, and phone number.
Add React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's profile and use them from the Profile page. Hooks must be placed alongside the existing query hooks pattern.

Update React Query hooks to support the new wallet APIs: add queries for (a) caller balance and (b) admin balance, plus a mutation for (c) admin distributing balance to a user. Ensure relevant queries are invalidated/refetched after successful transactions so the UI updates immediately after each transaction.

Show the authenticated user's balance in the top-left corner of the website on all pages (Home, Dashboard, Status, Credits, Admin, Profile), using a clean, modern, mobile-friendly UI element that does not obstruct content and adapts to small screens.

Update the Admin dashboard page to display the admin total wallet balance (10,000 initial minus distributed amounts) in addition to existing analytics, and ensure this value updates immediately after any admin-to-user distribution.

Replace any existing frontend-only 'admin balance' mechanics used for allocations (e.g., local state in the Dashboard) with the backend-backed admin wallet so that user funding and admin balance changes are consistent across sessions/devices and across pages.

Increase the visibility and discoverability of the fixed top-left BalanceIndicator (wallet/balance UI) so it is clearly noticeable on both mobile and desktop. Update its size, spacing, contrast, and positioning while keeping it fixed in the top-left on all pages.

Update the fixed top-left wallet/balance UI (BalanceIndicator) positioning so that on pages with the main site header branding (the "TikTok Booster Pro" title/logo), the wallet badge appears in the top-left area directly *below* the "TikTok Booster Pro" branding (not overlapping it), while remaining fixed and discoverable on both mobile and desktop.

Reposition the fixed wallet/balance indicator (BalanceIndicator) so it appears in the top-right corner of the UI, directly underneath the Profile control/button, on all pages where the global wallet indicator is shown.

Update the shared layout/CSS positioning utilities used by BalanceIndicator to support a safe top-right fixed placement (including safe-area inset handling and the existing header-height offset variable) and apply it from BalanceIndicator.

Implement the provided fixed balance + wallet link HTML snippet as a React UI pattern by updating the existing global BalanceIndicator to include an additional clearly visible action labeled "Wallet" (English text only), while keeping the balance indicator fixed in the safe top-right position underneath the Profile control on all pages.

Update the global BalanceIndicator so the balance UI is visible on the Home (index) page even when the user is not logged in, showing a default balance of 0 PKR (equivalent to the provided PHP example behavior). The component must still show the real authenticated user balance when logged in.

Adjust the BalanceIndicator actions for unauthenticated users so the UI does not suggest wallet access that requires login (e.g., hide or disable the "Wallet" button when not authenticated, or route it to the Profile/Login page), while keeping the current behavior unchanged for authenticated users.

Update the frontend balance-allocation flow to clearly reflect the backend-enforced admin-wallet check and deduction: after a successful allocation, the Admin Wallet balance shown in the Dashboard and Admin pages must update immediately; if allocation is rejected due to insufficient funds, show an English validation/toast error and keep the displayed balances unchanged.

Update the global BalanceIndicator so that when the signed-in user is an admin, the UI also shows the Admin Wallet Balance (in PKR) in the same fixed balance widget shown on the index/home page (and wherever BalanceIndicator is rendered), without changing the existing behavior for non-admin users.

Prevent unauthorized admin-wallet lookups from breaking the BalanceIndicator UI: the app must not surface an error state in BalanceIndicator for non-admin users due to calling the admin-wallet API; instead, it should treat admin-wallet data as unavailable and simply not render the admin-wallet portion of the UI.

Ensure the displayed Admin Wallet balance in the BalanceIndicator reflects backend state (Motoko adminWallet): after a successful admin-to-user distribution, the Admin Wallet balance shown in the UI updates without requiring a full page refresh.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create Express server for tiktok-booster serving a landing page with packages (Starter/Pro/VIP) and URL input order form UI.
Add /credits route with credits/contact info page and back link to home.
Add referral/share section: show current URL and provide 'copy URL' button (client-side clipboard).
Implement order tracking and status page: /status/:id shows order details (url, package, status, time).
Add /admin analytics page to display total orders and JSON dump of orders.

Add a simple dashboard-style home page ("Caffeine TikTok Booster") showing balance, quick order simulation, recent orders list, and basic user management UI backed by in-memory users/orders and an /api/users endpoint.

Implement dashboard data in the Motoko backend (single-actor) to support the dashboard features shown in the provided Express code: maintain a collection of users (id, name, balance, ref) and expose methods to (a) list users, (b) add a user (with referral code), and (c) get a combined dashboard payload equivalent to the Express endpoint GET /api/users returning {users, orders}. Keep existing Order functionality intact.
Update package pricing/options to PKR with more tiers (e.g., 50 PKR=5k views+500 likes, 100 PKR=10k views+1k likes+shares) and reflect price differences across packages.
Add/adjust delivery time options for orders (e.g., selectable 5–10 minutes duration) and display them in the order flow/UI.
Set dashboard starting balance to 10,000 PKR and support allocating/dividing balance across newly added users.
Extend user management to allow adding users by URL (store the URL on the user record and show it in the UI).
Add additional dashboard sections/options for managing 'Profile', 'Project', and 'Draft' (exact behavior/fields TBD).

Update the Motoko backend to support the new user URL field and the new allocation-based user creation: modify addUser to accept a URL parameter and store it in the user record; ensure dashboard queries return it. If the canister already has persisted users, add a conditional migration to preserve existing users by defaulting the new URL field to an empty string.

Create a clean, modern, mobile-friendly Profile section/page accessible from the top-right that supports profile picture upload, username + bio, email + phone fields, edit profile, change password, save changes, and logout.
Extend the backend UserProfile model to support the new Profile page fields and update existing profile methods to use the updated model without breaking the existing authorization checks.

Implement a wallet/balance system with an admin wallet (initial 10,000) that can distribute balance to users (admin-only), decreasing admin balance accordingly; store balances securely in the database; show user balance in the top-left on all pages and show admin total balance in the admin dashboard; balances update in real time after each transaction; clean, modern, mobile-friendly UI.

Implement a persistent wallet/balance model in the Motoko backend with (a) a single admin wallet that starts at a balance of 10,000 and (b) per-user balances, such that balances are stored in stable canister state (persistent across upgrades) and not only in frontend/local state.

Add backend methods to (a) fetch the caller's current balance, (b) fetch the admin wallet balance (admin-only), and (c) allow the admin to distribute/transfer an amount from the admin wallet to a specific user such that the admin balance decreases by the same amount and the user balance increases by the same amount.

Define how users are identified for balance transfers using the existing authentication model: the backend must store user balances keyed to the authenticated user identity (Internet Identity Principal), and the admin must be able to distribute funds to a specific user identity used by the app.

Reposition the wallet/balance indicator UI so it appears in the top-right corner under the Profile control (instead of top-left), and ensure it is visible/discoverable on mobile and desktop across pages.

Display the logged-in user's wallet balance on the index/home page by fetching it from persistent storage at request time (user-authenticated; show 0 when not logged in). User provided a PHP session + MySQL example, so align/port this behavior to the app’s actual backend/auth stack.

Ensure the Motoko backend admin wallet has an initial balance of 10,000 (PKR) and that this value is not reset unexpectedly after canister upgrades/redeployments; admin distributions to users must always deduct from this admin wallet balance.

Implement backend-persistent admin wallet state that starts at 10,000 PKR and is not reset on canister upgrade/redeploy, matching the provided SQL example behavior of a single admin record with balance=10000.

Ensure admin-to-user balance allocation follows the provided PHP logic atomically: before allocating an initial balance to a user, verify admin wallet balance >= requested allocation; on success, credit the user and deduct the same amount from the admin wallet within the same backend call; on failure, do not change either balance.
Show the admin wallet balance on the index/home page as well (for admin users), in addition to the existing user balance indicator behavior.
